suite_role: Independent unseen validation after V2 freeze
not_included_note: No runs on these problems were performed in the original development, diagnostic, or frozen-validation experiments. They were evaluated in revision with the frozen configuration and no retuning; see data/remaining_problems/.
excluded_note: No feasible solution has been reported for G20, so objective error and the feasibility-first ranking are undefined.
v2_frozen_change: Budget-neutral finite-difference multi-equality projection, trigger after 4 stagnant iterations, attempted every third iteration, up to 6 sensitivity-selected dimensions, finite-difference step 1e-3 of variable span; projection evaluations replace ordinary trials so total NFE remains 5000.
